prompt: Vertical 9:16 night photograph on grainy 35 mm colour-negative film, the camera low and close beside the right-hand end of a roadside glass shelter in the rain, as if sitting at the very end of its narrow perch seat with the brushed-steel seat edge just visible at the bottom of frame. Coming in from the right, past the poster case, the first spill of flashing blue light from an ambulance not yet in view is starting to colour the rain streaks and the wet tarmac of the near lane, reaching across toward the left. Lights in the scene: the poster case backlight, the sodium street lamps, the growing blue wash. Film grain, gentle halation, no people, no readable text except on the poster, no signs, no plates, no route numbers. A real photograph, not CGI. Thanks.
